decision: Implement the pinned Coloc2 workflow with independently authored C++ processing, commands, results and report services, the shared Dear ImGui panels and Python bindings. Upstream Java sources and JARs remain reference evidence only; do not copy, translate, link, bundle or execute them in the shipped product.

complete_scope_preserved.workflow_groups: All eleven W01-W11 groups in the pinned proposal, all commercially eligible discovered options and applicable C++/Python/shared ImGui interactions remain required.
complete_scope_preserved.reports: Retain full applicable report/PDF behavior. Coefficient-only or CSV-only output cannot substitute for it.

remaining_gates: Extract the exact options, defaults and lifetimes of all three pinned descriptors; their option inventories are still null.
Settle the typed channel-pair, axis, ROI/mask, calibration, threshold, statistics, results, plots, report and replay contracts with literal expectations.
Qualify independent reference inputs and execution separately from incorporation and product distribution.
Review exact new owned implementations, derivation, native dependencies and redistributed assets before incorporation or shipment.
Deliver every retained workflow and option through applicable C++ API, Python API and both ImGui launch modes, including resource, history, persistence and release checks.
commercial_boundary: Route selection is not a clean-room, non-derivative or legal eligibility finding. Preserve all existing root Coloc2, iText, glyphlist, AFM and transitive decisions at their original scope. Pending, NC, research-only and unlicensed incorporated material remains excluded; copyleft alone is not a non-commercial restriction.
alternate_route_trigger: Any proposed copied, translated, linked or distributed upstream member requires a separately reviewed route/dependency/material decision before that member is incorporated.
next_action: One bounded reference owner produces the complete three-descriptor option/default map and consumed native workflow contract. Reuse retained source/resource reviews; do not repeat unchanged Java dependency leaves or wait for unrelated whole-family completion.
